name: 440 Meter Dodgeball Death Race
author: dkobrien
description:
Welcome to THE dystopian track and field event of our dystopian future. Can you beat both the clock and automated weaponry? Will you hear the roar of the crowd or sad music as they carry your unconscious body off of the field?

I originally intended to 'just spend a little time' looking into how to use rigidbodys to use physics to make objects move.  It quickly got out of hand.
